bootstrap_unit: question after averaging its ten orders
case_selection_rule: Lexicographically first held-out question meeting each stated failure/disagreement condition; earliest qualifying saved order for stopping; descriptive post-hoc examples.

identity.quartile_policy: 8 highest/lowest candidates per question, ties by saved order 0; full-pool retrospective diagnostics
identity.correlations: Spearman across candidates within question; Pearson confidence/vision across tokens within rollout then mean within question; undefined correlations retained as null and counted
identity.rwc: Exact integer units proportional to prescribed descending-average-rank weights; vote ties by earliest supporting candidate
identity.zero_tokens: This export was audited to have none; fail if that assumption changes.
